parole.significato: doge (chief magistrate in the republics of Venice and Genoa)
parole.testo: From Venetan doxe or Italian doge, from Latin ducem, accusative of dux (“leader; commander; ruler”). Doublet of duque.

parole.significato: lagoon (shallow body of water separated from the sea by a bar)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Venetan laguna, Italian laguna, from Latin lacuna. Cf. also Spanish laguna. Doublet of lagoa, which was inherited from Latin, and of lacuna, which was borrowed.
Borrowed from Venetan połenta or Italian polenta.
